name: Motiff
title: motiff.com
shortDescription: Motiff is an AI-powered interface design tool that transforms the way UIs are created. It integrates seamlessly into design workflows, particularly for designers and developers who use Figma. An example use case is a designer generating UI components directly from text descriptions, speeding up the prototyping process.
pros: Generates UIs from text and images
Integrates with Figma for easy access
cons: May not fully replace human creativity

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Sketch
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Popular among macOS users for UI design
